resources.string: Add web addresses or masks to create routing rules.
HTTP/HTTPS · Domains · Domain masks · IPv4/IPv6 · CIDR · IP ranges
Enter a valid domain, HTTP/HTTPS URL, domain mask, CIDR network or IP range.

Web rules apply to traffic captured by the current VPN scenario, including Whole device. Choose VPN, Direct or Block for each rule. Block applies only while VPN runs. Hold a rule to delete it. Live changes use the existing atomic traffic barrier and reconnection.
URLs apply to the entire host. *.example.com includes example.com and its subdomains; *.ru covers the zone.
